publicationPolicy.scope: Five retained English and Spanish county research routes
publicationPolicy.rule: Publish the research method and direct primary-source links, not copied market tables or unsourced market values.
publicationPolicy.snapshotRule: Do not present a monthly or quarterly market snapshot unless downstream republication rights and the exact geography, property category, reporting period, metric definitions, and source date are verified.
publicationPolicy.legacyQuarterRule: The retained Hudson and Middlesex URLs include Q2 2026 for continuity only; their title, description, H1, and direct answer must describe a source guide and must not promise a Q2 report.
publicationPolicy.countyRule: County sources do not answer municipality-level or property-specific questions.
publicationPolicy.propertyRule: A property-specific CMA requires current comparable properties and property details.
publicationPolicy.corrections: Source-link or labeling corrections may be sent through the site contact page.

publicationRightsReview.finding: The public portal identifies its reports as copyrighted by ShowingTime Plus, and the reviewed New Jersey Realtors terms do not grant express republication permission.
publicationRightsReview.decision: Link readers to the original report selector and do not reproduce a monthly or quarterly portal table.

sharedSources.title: 10K Market Data
sharedSources.use: Confirm the official route to public state and county reports and the publication cadence described by New Jersey Realtors.
sharedSources.limit: The page states that municipality reports are a member resource; this guide does not represent county data as municipality data.

sharedSources.title: Public State and County Reports
sharedSources.use: Let readers select the county, report period, and available property category at the source.
sharedSources.limit: Values can change with the selected report and period. This site links to the portal and does not copy its tables.
sharedSources.publicationHandling: direct public county-report portal linked by NJ Realtors; tables are viewed at the source and are not reproduced

sharedSources.title: Terms of Service
sharedSources.use: Check whether the publisher grants express permission to reproduce its service or report content.
sharedSources.limit: This is a publication-rights check, not a housing-market data source.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: Property Tax Statistics
sharedSources.geography: New Jersey, county, and taxing district depending on table
sharedSources.use: Find the Division of Taxation's property-tax statistical tables and definitions.
sharedSources.limit: Assessment and tax statistics are not listing-service market statistics or a valuation of a particular property.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: 2025 Average Residential Statistics
sharedSources.use: Read the table using its exact labels: # of Line Items, Avg Assessment, Avg Tax Bill, # of Sales, and Avg Sales Price.
sharedSources.limit: The published values are averages, not medians; district rows should not be presented as one countywide value or as a current CMA.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: County Equalization Tables
sharedSources.geography: New Jersey county and taxing district
sharedSources.use: Review county equalization tables in their tax-administration context.
sharedSources.limit: Equalized valuation concepts are not a listing price, appraisal, or prediction of a future sale.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
sharedSources.title: Construction Reporter
sharedSources.use: Research building-permit and certificate-of-occupancy activity reported by local officials.
sharedSources.limit: Permits and certificates are development activity indicators, not a count of homes for sale and not a market prediction.

sharedSources.title: American Community Survey Data Profiles
sharedSources.geography: United States geographic areas including counties
sharedSources.period: ACS profile release selected by the user
sharedSources.use: Confirm the purpose of ACS data profiles and use Selected Housing Characteristics profile DP04 for county context.
sharedSources.limit: ACS values are survey estimates for the stated release and geography, not current transactions, listings, or appraisals.
